lines.text: James tells his brothers not to show favoritism, giving a seat of honor to the man in fine clothes.
God has chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom.
The rich oppress the believers, drag them into prison, and blaspheme the noble name by which they are called.
Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
James says judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not kept the Sabbath.
